Class AnnotationDefaults

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.inject.annotation.AnnotationDefaults
@Internal public final class AnnotationDefaults extends Object
The defaults an annotation type declares, read from the type itself and keyed by the type.

AnnotationMetadataSupport.getDefaultValues(String) answers from a registry keyed by annotation name, which generated code fills in as classes load. That registry serves the accessors of metadata built at compilation time, where the defaults are written into the generated class; it is the wrong source for anything that has the annotation type in hand, for two reasons. It is mutable and filled in over the life of the process, so the same question can be answered differently depending on what has been loaded, and it is keyed by name, so the same annotation name defined by two class loaders resolves to whichever was registered last.

What is read here is a property of the type alone: the Method.getDefaultValue() of each of its members, converted into the shapes the metadata records values in. A ClassValue keys it by the class rather than the name, so two deployments of the same annotation name keep their own defaults, and nothing outside can change what a type answers.

5.2.0
